title: Personal Answer: send, retry, cancel and decisions under personal_answer_v1
why: SOPHIA-INC-2026-11 INC-03, INC03-CC-003 A2: the HTTP boundary for migration 0101's Answer operation (send, retry and cancel of an automatic_v1 input, each an immutable decision) and its owner read. Its generated output is regenerated with `pnpm --filter @sophia/contracts generate`, never by hand.

New paths and versioned schemas, not variants of A52: A52's record-only /api/v1/personal/inputs, its PersonalInputSend body and its PersonalInputRecorded receipt mean the same whether this operation is served or not, and the legacy PersonalMessage is untouched.

Closed requests: the answer contract is explicit; the owner is the verified actor; the trusted answer profile (payer, route, model, effort, ceiling, prices, role) is the server's live companion's, never a field. Retry and cancel name the decision seq they expect.

Closed responses: a receipt carries its own decision, never the latest or the profile; the decision list carries identity, decision metadata and times in seq order, and deliberately omits the frozen profile and every diagnostic.

Served only when the API is built with Personal answers (off by default; the server does not set it). What follows a committed send or retry (the answer, through migration 0102's effect guard) is not part of any response.

answerContract.description: The versioned Answer operation, explicit and required. No other value, no default; a legacy PersonalMessage or an A52 PersonalInputSend is a different request.

value.description: A Personal message for Sophia to answer under personal_answer_v1: kept as an automatic_v1 input and decided at once. Closed: the owner, profile, payer, route, model, prices, audience, origin and context are the server's, never the request's.
An explicit retry of a waiting input, naming the latest decision seq the caller saw.
An explicit cancel of a waiting input, naming the latest decision seq the caller saw. Terminal; the words stay held.
One immutable decision of an input, as its operation made it. admittedAt is set exactly when admitted. Never the answer profile.
What an Answer mutation remembers and every replay of it returns: its own decision, never the latest one, a refreshed time or the profile.
A decision and when it was made. Its frozen answer profile is deliberately not part of it.

decisions.description: Every decision of the input, in seq order from 1: the current one is the last.

value.description: The owner's own read of one input's decisions: identity, decision metadata and times only, no profile, payer, route, body or diagnostic.

post.summary: The owner's message under personal_answer_v1: kept as an automatic_v1 input and decided at once under the server's trusted answer profile (admitted, or waiting while its payer is not admitted). An admitted input's turn waits for Sophia's answer, which is paid for only while the live settings still match the admitted profile. Served only when the API is built with Personal answers (off by default). Idempotent per person and key, in the one Personal key namespace.

parameters.name: x-sophia-personal-epoch
parameters.description: The epoch of the space the write is made against (PersonalSpace.epoch). A write made against another epoch, so one issued before an erasure however late it arrives, is refused (409 request_erased) and writes nothing.

202.description: Decided: the receipt of this send and its decision (seq 1); after it commits, the owner's oldest waiting turn is resumed

404.description: Personal answers are not served by this API (off by default)

409.description: Idempotency key reused with a different request, including another Personal operation (idempotency_conflict); a write against an epoch an erasure has since moved, or under a key from before it (request_erased); a stale expectedSeq (stale_revision); or an input that is not waiting for a decision (invalid_state)

422.description: Request fails the declared schema (unknown fields such as profile, payer, routeId, model, ownerId or interactionContract are refused), or the input is not the caller's or was kept without an answer admission (not_found)

503.description: Personal answers are not installed on this database (projection_unavailable), the database is unavailable, Sophia does not answer this person live (nothing was kept), or the write's outcome is unknown: retry with the same Idempotency-Key

post.summary: An explicit retry of a waiting input, under its own key: one new decision under the server's current answer profile, admitted or still waiting. Served only with Personal answers.
